behavior: A toast with no title takes its accessible name from its description: `aria-labelledby` has the id of the description, and the toast has no `aria-describedby`. WAI-ARIA requires a name for the roles `dialog` and `alertdialog`. A toast that has an `aria-label` or an `aria-labelledby` of the consumer keeps that name and its description. Base UI gives a toast with no title no name.
